records.text: An unidentified CNN panelist said Candace Owens was one of the most disgusting people to get airplay on a major network.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #11 (Ep LATnak75Si0)

appearances.snippet: Not only is she stupid, but she's also disgusting, right? I mean, Candace (Candace Owens) has got to be one of the most disgusting folks whoever gets airplay on any major network.

verification.notes: CNN’s official transcript identifies Harry Enten as the panelist and records him saying Candace Owens was one of the most disgusting people who ever gets airplay on any major network. The extracted statement correctly preserves the opinion, although the speaker no longer needs to be treated as unidentified for verification purposes.

sources.title: CNN Table for Five transcript, July 26, 2025
sources.relevance: Official CNN transcript attributes the quoted opinion to Harry Enten.
